summary: Final pre-production regression (backend + frontend, desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844). Backend: iteration 13 + 14 suites rerun (SMS tests skipped so SMS stays untouched) gave 27/30 pass; the 3 TestTickets failures happen only because the seed ticket test-ticket-1 no longer exists (support_tickets is empty), not because of an app bug. New suite tests/test_iteration15_final_regression.py: 12 pass, 1 skipped (crypto simulation, because NOWPayments has LIVE keys here), 2 genuine FAILURES: (1) CRITICAL: a forged, unauthenticated Hubtel success callback marks an application PAID; (2) HIGH: a non-success Hubtel callback downgrades an already-paid application to payment_status=failed. These work: processing tiers (350/375/400 tourist, 750/775/800 business), business-field validation, document upload, Hubtel sandbox initiate+confirm (submitted + admin_payment_success emails, idempotent second confirm), track (404 when unpaid, status shown when paid), admin in_progress/done emails, admin search and date filters (API), transactions list/detail/CSV/XLSX (valid xlsx with 2 sheets and 13 columns; CSV injection guarded), failed-event idempotency (1 dispatch per admin recipient, so 2 admins give 2 email_log rows; payment_notifications_log attempts=1), Abena multi-turn chat, monitoring check-now, audit log, auth guards, SMS still disabled. Frontend: all public pages load with no horizontal overflow on desktop and mobile, the mobile header menu works, Abena opens on mobile and answers multi-turn correctly, and the full apply flow works in the UI (business fields toggle, live totals, 4 uploads, sandbox payment, success page, track). Admin works on desktop: KPIs, view modal, In Progress/Done, Payments search/drawer/CSV+XLSX download, Tickets (empty), Monitoring, Activity, Settings SMS tab (looked at only, nothing saved). Mobile UI blockers: the WhatsApp button is fully covered by the Abena button, and the admin panel has no navigation on mobile. Dashboard UI has no search/date/pagination controls.

critical.issue: PAYMENT BYPASS: the callback has no authentication or verification. A public POST of {Status:'Success', ResponseCode:'0000', Data:{ClientReference:<tracking>, Status:'Success'}} with any CheckoutId (even with no prior /payments/initiate) runs _mark_application_paid, which sends the 'submitted' email and admin_payment_success and puts the app in the paid queue. The code only logs a CheckoutId mismatch. Reproduced in test_unsigned_success_callback_marks_paid. The same code path runs in live mode, so anyone can get a visa processed without paying.

A Failed/Cancelled callback runs $set payment_status='failed' with no guard on the paid state. An already-paid application becomes payment_status=failed (status stays 'submitted'), so it disappears from the dashboard (which filters payment_status=paid), /api/track returns 404 and revenue drops. A spoofed or late duplicate callback is enough. Same issue in /api/payments/confirm with success=false. Reproduced in test_failed_callback_after_paid_must_not_downgrade.

minor.issue: Check-then-update is not atomic: it reads payment_status and then calls update_one without a filter on payment_status!='paid'. A webhook and a confirm arriving at the same time can send duplicate customer and admin emails. Use update_one({tracking_no, payment_status:{$ne:'paid'}}) and check modified_count.
processing_label maps every non-express app to 'Regular (5–7 days)', so priority customers get the wrong processing label in the 'submitted' and admin_payment_success emails.
Does not check payment_status: an admin (or a script) can set an unpaid application to in_progress/done and send the customer status emails.

The brief says NOWPayments runs in simulation, but the preview DB has LIVE NOWPayments keys (sandbox=false, api_key and ipn_secret set). /api/payments/crypto/initiate created a REAL live invoice (about 315 USDT TRC20, unpaid, will expire) and simulate-finish cannot be used. This confirms the live create_payment integration works, but test runs in preview create real invoices.
Hubtel is shown as 'Operational' with HTTP 404 (up = status_code < 500). A 404 from the probed URL should probably not count as healthy in live mode.

ui_bugs.issue: Both floating buttons are fixed at bottom-24 on the right (WhatsApp right-4 z-40, Abena right-6 z-50). On a 390px viewport Abena sits on top of WhatsApp (bbox x=310 vs x=318, same y=692), so the WhatsApp widget cannot be opened on mobile. Playwright click timed out with 'abena-open intercepts pointer events'.

The sidebar is 'hidden md:flex' and there is no hamburger or mobile nav. On 390px the admin cannot move between Dashboard/Payments/Tickets/Monitoring/Settings/Activity or sign out (only typed URLs work).
Business visa fields (company_name, host_company, business_registration, business_address, purpose_of_visit) are not shown in the View modal, although the API returns them.

integration_issues.issue: The backend supports search/from_date/to_date/page/page_size, but AdminDashboard.jsx only sends ?status=. There is no search box, no date filter and no pagination in the UI. With more than 100 paid applications, older ones never appear on the dashboard (default page_size=100). Only the Payments page has search and dates.

issues: Native browser date pickers (input type=date) instead of the shadcn Calendar
The dark Abena button (bottom-right) sits on the black footer and is almost invisible
Sonner toasts cover the Export CSV/Excel buttons in the top-right corner
Every reply starts again with 'Hello! I'm Abena, your AI Customer Success Agent' in multi-turn chats (prompt tweak)

action_items: CRITICAL (blocks deployment): secure /api/webhooks/hubtel. Before marking paid, verify the transaction server-side with Hubtel's Transaction Status Check API (by clientReference / CheckoutId, using the merchant POS sales id and basic auth), check that the amount and currency match the stored amount_charged, and require a stored payment_transaction_id from /payments/initiate. An optional extra is an allowlist of Hubtel callback IPs.

HIGH: never downgrade a paid application. In the non-success webhook branch and in /payments/confirm success=false, use update_one({tracking_no, payment_status:{$ne:'paid'}}) and skip the failed alert when already paid.
HIGH: fix the mobile overlap of the WhatsApp and Abena floating buttons (e.g. stack Abena at bottom-44 on mobile, or combine them).
HIGH: add a mobile navigation (hamburger/drawer) to AdminLayout.
MEDIUM: wire the dashboard search, from/to date and pagination UI to the existing /api/admin/applications params (Lot 1 is backend-only right now).
MEDIUM: show the business visa fields in the admin application detail modal.
LOW: make _mark_application_paid atomic; fix processing_label for priority; block status changes on unpaid applications; count only 2xx/expected codes as up in the Hubtel health probe.
Decide whether the preview environment should keep LIVE NOWPayments keys (test runs create real invoices).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2772 lines and should be split into routers (payments, admin, settings, chat, cron).
hubtel_webhook stores the raw callback but trusts it fully. The docstring says 'We verify the transaction against our own initiate record', but the mismatch branch only logs.
The admin email-log endpoint is hard-capped at 100 newest entries with no pagination or filters.

rca of the issue: Webhook bypass: hubtel_webhook (server.py ~873-941) decides success only from the posted JSON (_hubtel_success) and calls _mark_application_paid without any server-side check with Hubtel. Repro: create an application, then curl -X POST /api/webhooks/hubtel -d '{"ResponseCode":"0000","Status":"Success","Data":{"ClientReference":"GH-...","Status":"Success"}}'; /api/payments/status shows paid. Downgrade: the else branch sets payment_status=failed with no paid guard. Mobile WhatsApp: WhatsAppButton.jsx:45 and AbenaChat.jsx:55 both use bottom-24 on the right on mobile. Admin mobile nav: AdminLayout.jsx:33 aside is hidden below md and has no fallback.
